paper_title: Shuttle Between the Instructions and the Parameters of Large Language   Models
caption: : The loss curve of SHIP-pretrain with respect to the training steps.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the changes in different loss values over a sequence of training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Steps" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick labels displayed at 100-step intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and employs a linear scale from 0 to 8. A blue line, represented by a solid line with small circle markers, begins at a value of approximately 4.2 at the start of the x-axis and decreases to a value of approximately 0.8 at the end of the x-axis, showing fluctuating decreasing trends. A purple line, depicted as a solid line with triangle markers, starts at about 3.7 and decreases to approximately 1.8 across the x-axis range, also showing fluctuating decreasing trends. A green line, shown using a solid line with square markers, initiates at approximately 2.3 and descends to around 0.7 at the end of the x-axis, with fluctuating decreasing trends throughout.
